description: Read the page as an accessibility outline (headings, text, links, buttons, fields). Elements you can act on carry a ref like e123 for browser_click and browser_type; plain elements the page made clickable show as "clickable". Refs stop working after the page changes, so take a new snapshot then. On long pages (dashboards, admin lists), pass find or interactiveOnly to read less.

find.description: Only the parts of the page that contain this text (any case), with what they sit in and what they hold, like a table row with its cells and buttons.

interactiveOnly.description: Only what you can act on (links, buttons, fields and anything else with a ref), plus the headings, as a flat list.

tabId.description: Tab id from browser_open_tab or browser_list_tabs.

name: browser_snapshot
